title: AccuWeather Forecast: 1 more dry day before rain and wind return for Level 2 storm - ABC7 Bay Area
text:
AccuWeather Forecast: 1 more dry day before rain and wind return for Level 2 storm - ABC7 San Francisco 
 24/7 Live San Francisco East Bay South Bay Peninsula North Bay WEATHER 
 AccuWeather Forecast: 1 more dry day before rain and wind return for Level 2 storm 
 ABC7 Eyewitness News Meteorologist Drew Tuma has the AccuWeather forecast. KGO Thursday, November 12, 2026 4:50PM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Takeaway of the Day One more dry day before rain and wind return Friday. Today, expect a mix of sun and clouds and a cooler afternoon with highs in the upper 60s to the mid 70s. A Coastal Flood Advisory continues today for minor coastal flooding during high tide. A Beach Hazard statement is also in effect along the coast for dangerous surf.
 TIMELINE: Storm to bring rain, dangerous surf to Bay Area and more than a foot of snow to the Sierra 
 A Look Ahead Rain and wind return Friday with a level 2 moderate storm on the ABC7 Exclusive Storm Impact Scale . Expect heavy rain, strong wind gusts and dangerous surf along our coast. Worst rain and wind will occur between 9am and 1pm. Rainfall totals will range from .50" to 1.5" and we could see localized flooding on our freeways. Scattered showers continue through the weekend and into early next week.
